specs.title: QA-S01 ordinary journey: enter, record, see server truth, refresh, recover
QA-S02 duplicate submission: rapid double-click cannot commit twice
QA-S02b repeated Enter keypresses cannot commit twice
QA-S02c a lost response plus retry commits exactly one record
QA-S02d submitting the same text twice as two separate intents
QA-S04 stale page: a submission naming another candidate is refused and explained
QA-S05 direct navigation to unlinked routes exposes nothing
QA-S06 ownership: a second identity cannot see the first identity records
QA-S07 an unauthenticated browser can neither read nor write
QA-S08 input abuse: validation, over-length, and markup are handled as text
QA-S09 sign out ends the session server-side and the cookie cannot be replayed
